model: UNI SPLIT DC inverter indoor units (integrated Modbus RTU)
equipment_type: VRF / split AC gateway (built-in indoor-unit Modbus)
applies_to: Sinclair All DC Inverter UNI SPLIT indoor units with the built-in Modbus RTU interface, per the UNI SPLIT Modbus user's manual.
summary: Sinclair's UNI SPLIT DC inverter indoor units have a Modbus RTU slave built into the indoor controller, so no separate gateway is needed; up to 255 units share one RS-485 line. Settings and analog values are 16-bit words (holding registers) and flags are coils. This map covers on/off, mode, fan, setpoint, swing, temperatures, remote locks and shields, feature flags, and the indoor, outdoor and inverter-drive fault bits.

addressing.note: Word and bit addresses start at 0 and go on the wire unchanged: 'Word 20' is holding register address 20 and 'Bit17' is coil address 17. The manual's read example (start address 00 01 for words 1-2) confirms the numbering.

source.title: User's manual UNI SPLIT Modbus
source.pages: pp. 2-3 (function codes), p. 7 (serial settings), pp. 8-12 (frame formats and examples), pp. 13-14 (precautions), pp. 15-43 (word and bit tables)

notes: All values are 16-bit words or single bits; there are no 32-bit values.
Function codes listed: 01 read coils, 03 read registers, 0F write coils and 10 write registers. Single-write codes 05 and 06 are not listed.
Reserved words and bits are left out, as are a few bits printed with no name (for example Bit125 and Bits 201-204 and 207, which have no value meaning).

When energy saving is active in cooling (or heating), a remote setpoint below the cooling lower limit (or above the heating upper limit) is ignored. The two energy-saving bits (32 and 33) must be set or cleared together.
After power-up, the module answers with exception 04 until it has valid data from the unit; 04 later means the module has lost contact with the air conditioner.
Several fault bits are printed with '1: yes 0: on', which reads as a typo for '0: no'; they are given here as 1 = fault.

integration.summary: Set the indoor unit to PC/Modbus address mode on the wired controller, then poll holding registers 0-83 with function 03 and coils 0-215 with function 01. Control by writing words 2, 17, 19 and 20 with function 16.
integration.enable: The Modbus interface is built into the indoor unit controller. Select the address mode and set the unit address on the wired controller (see the unit's service manual).
quirks: Writes must use function 16 (registers) or 15 (coils); function 06/05 are not listed.
The BMS and the unit's own controls act equally: the most recent command wins.
setup: RS-485 at 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
Up to 255 indoor units per RS-485 port; use another port for more.
Use twisted pair and keep it at least 15 cm from power cables.
gotchas: Exception 04 means the Modbus module can't reach the air conditioner, including right after power-up.
Heating commands are ignored on cooling-only units (check coil 177).
